about: What the four layers of APP-DESIGN §7.3 find for every baseline screen (manifest order) and then every case of the tC4 view-state gallery (cases.json order, APP-DESIGN §7.4): pixels, the DOM, what the DOM shows (meaning) and behaviour, between tC4's record (parity/tc4-baseline for a screen, parity/view-gallery for a case) and the Rust app's captures (captures.json). A case has no meaning layer. crates/tc-ui/tests/screen_record.rs computes it from the committed files and fails when this file differs; UPDATE_REPORT=1 cargo test -p tc-ui --test screen_record rewrites it. Status: same, declared (every difference inside a mask of masks.json), differs (explained in residuals.json), unported (`missing` names the unit that captures each layer), failed (nothing excuses it).
